name: browser-agent
description: Chrome MV3 browser layer + agent for get_state()-driven web automation.

scripts.package:ext: node build.mjs && rm -f browser-agent-extension.zip && cd extension && zip -qr -FS ../browser-agent-extension.zip manifest.json dist -x '*.map' && cd ..
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build && npm --prefix agent install && npm --prefix agent run build
